Read the files under .tools/ directory, especially .tools/codex/config.toms and .envrc and troubleshoot why running the `codex resume` command does not list the past sessions, while executing the `codex resume --all` does show past sessions, using the same directory `/var/tmp/HN_CLIENTS` specified in the codex config file.

The goal of that configuration is that the source code directory can be moved to any location on the filesystem, but by creating a symlink to the actual location, nothing in the configuration needs to be changed, and the codex session logs will contain the path /var/tmp/... in session logs, hence the codex will work seamlessly irrespective of where a developer clones the Git repository on their filesystem, and be able to see all the session history of the project.
